decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while deploying threats quickly to apply pressure. Utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption, it aims to control the board while steadily advancing its own game state. With a mix of versatile creatures like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent, as well as powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, the deck seeks to outmaneuver and outpace the opponent, securing victory through a combination of tempo advantage and card advantage.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bringing them back onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and control the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, powerful creature reanimation while disrupting their plans to win the game.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through discard spells like Thoughtseize and Hymn to Tourach, while also utilizing powerful reanimation spells like Reanimate to bring back key creatures from the graveyard. The deck also relies on Leyline of the Void to shut down graveyard strategies, and uses Helm of Obedience to mill cards from the opponent's library. With a mix of disruption, graveyard manipulation, and combo potential with cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Beseech the Mirror, this deck aims to control the game and win through its combo pieces.

This deck revolves around quickly getting powerful creatures onto the battlefield by using cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes powerful counterspells like Flusterstorm and Force of Will to protect your combo pieces. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with massive creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and establish board control with cards like The One Ring and Omniscience. The deck relies on fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide to accelerate its game plan and win the game before the opponent can react.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of fast mana spells and creature recursion to quickly mill the entire deck, then use Thassa's Oracle to win the game by having no cards left in the library. The deck focuses on casting a large number of spells in a single turn to overwhelm the opponent and win before they have a chance to react. The deck also includes disruption spells like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and ensure its success.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while maintaining tempo and aggression. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Stifle, and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also utilizing efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Molten Collapse to keep the board clear, the deck aims to control the pace of the game. With a mix of powerful creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Nethergoyf, along with card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Snapcaster Mage, this deck aims to apply pressure and outvalue the opponent.

The deck is focused on quickly deploying powerful Dragons and disrupting the opponent's mana base with Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void. It also utilizes artifact acceleration to cast its threats ahead of schedule. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and deny them the ability to cast spells effectively, leading to a swift victory.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, using cards like Entomb and Animate Dead, to bring them back onto the battlefield for a strong offensive strategy. It also includes control elements like Daze and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces and disrupt opponents' strategies. With a mix of card draw and disruption, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with high-powered threats.

This deck focuses on quickly applying pressure on the opponent by utilizing efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with disruption spells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland while maintaining card advantage through cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm. The deck's mana base is optimized for fast and consistent casting of spells, with the ability to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Ultimately, this deck aims to tempo out opponents and close out the game quickly.

The central theme of this Grixis Aggro deck is to quickly deploy aggressive threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with efficient countermagic and removal spells. The deck aims to apply pressure early with cards like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, while also utilizing disruptive spells like Lightning Bolt, Daze, and Force of Will to control the tempo of the game. The deck also includes a few versatile cards like Polluted Delta and Mishra's Bauble to further enhance its speed and consistency.

The main idea of this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly and aggressively lock down the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void while deploying powerful threats like Broadside Bombardiers and Pyrogoyf. By disrupting the opponent's game plan and presenting a fast clock, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory before they have a chance to recover. Additionally, using cards like The One Ring and Shatterskull Smashing provide additional utility and versatility to handle a variety of threats.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand using spells like Dark Ritual, Reanimate, and Animate Dead. It uses cards like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's hand and protect the combo pieces. The inclusion of cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Troll of Khazad-dûm adds versatility and resilience to the deck. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats and disrupt their game plan to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with artifacts such as Mox Opal and Lotus Petal, while using cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga to generate advantage and threats. The key strategy is to control the board with cheap artifacts and disruption like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will, while also utilizing the artifact synergies to close out the game with powerful threats like Thought Monitor and Patchwork Automaton. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and resource denial.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces needed to cast Doomsday and win the game using Thassa's Oracle. It includes cards like Personal Tutor and Thoughtseize to find and protect the combo pieces, along with disruption like Force of Will and Daze to control the game. The key strategy is to set up a winning pile with Doomsday, Thassa's Oracle, and enough cards to ensure victory when Doomsday resolves. The deck excels at quickly assembling the combo and winning before the opponent has a chance to disrupt the plan.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling and casting the card Doomsday to set up a winning combination involving Thassa's Oracle or drawing cards with Deep Analysis. The deck includes a heavy amount of card selection and disruption to ensure the combo can be executed efficiently. The goal is to win the game in a single turn by carefully manipulating the contents of the deck and casting key spells at the right time. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will helps protect the combo and disrupt opponents' game plans while striving for a quick and decisive victory.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck includes cards like Dark Ritual, Cabal Ritual, and Lotus Petal to quickly generate mana, as well as Personal Tutor to search for Doomsday. Force of Will and Thoughtseize provide disruption against opponents, while Brainstorm and Ponder help with card selection and digging for key pieces. The inclusion of Daze and The One Ring offers additional protection and flexibility in gameplay. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently execute its combo win condition while controlling the game.
